entry.headline: Extended — wait for a pullback
entry.headline_zh: 过度拉伸 — 等待回撤
entry.action: You missed the bottoming entry — the low already formed and price is now extended (overbought (daily RSI 72)). Don't chase; wait for a pullback to the 10-day average or the next cycle low. Hold if already long.
